_about: ROWS-1 (operator look ruling 2026-10-26, ruling 18): the ONE field set of a list row. A row has three lines: the short name (up to two lines), one line of stored reader text, one meta line. ListRow draws nothing that is not named here; a row type lists its meta fields in the order they are drawn. `drop` ranks the chips a narrow row sets aside whole, with a count, when the meta line does not fit (the date and the tier are never dropped; rank 1 goes first). `absence` is `omit` (the field is not drawn) or `dash` (the one quiet dash of the absence table, with its needs-phrase on the title).

names.act_short_name: core/lists/display-title.ts shortName: act head, number and the subject clause of the title's own grammar; a title with no recognised head passes through
names.source_title: the item's title as stored (a community post: the post's title)

summary.source: intelligence_items.what_is_it (a community post: the stored body excerpt)

type.source: intelligence_items.item_type through core/lists/data/item-type.json; a reference row (a watched source or series, a portfolio entity) names its own kind

due.source: core/lists dueInfo: the nearest future day of compliance_deadline and the timeline

group.source: the post's group name (the community search hit)
